lines.en: My broken armor drags on the ground...
There is a place for me among the corpses...
You would do as an offering...
Don't move. The rite has begun...

lines.zh: 呻吟着倒下，肉皮松垂，腐烂不堪。
lines.en: Groaning as it falls, flesh hanging in tatters.

lines.zh: 惨叫一声，腐皮在地面撕裂。
lines.en: A scream as its rotten skin rips on the ground.
Howling as its flesh begins to rot.

lines.zh: 发出尖锐的叫声，腐肉崩裂。
lines.en: A shrill cry as its rotting flesh tears.
Sputtering as it falls, flesh rotting.
Screaming in pain, rotten flesh dripping.
Screaming as it falls, flesh tearing apart.
Howling as rotten flesh falls to the ground.
Screaming as its rotten flesh tears apart.

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒盯着你手中的面包，眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: The rotten cultist eyeing your bread with greedy eyes.

lines.zh: 你递出一块面包，腐烂邪教徒露出狰狞的微笑。
lines.en: You offer a piece of bread, the rotten cultist grins savagely.

lines.zh: 你手中的面包似乎对腐烂邪教徒有致命吸引力。
lines.en: The bread in your hand seems to have a fatal吸引力 to the rotten cultist.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒靠近你，试图抢夺你手中的面包。
lines.en: The rotten cultist approaches, trying to snatch your bread.

lines.zh: 你给了腐烂邪教徒一块面包，他贪婪地咀嚼着。
lines.en: You give the rotten cultist a piece of bread, which he greedily munches.

lines.zh: 面包是腐烂邪教徒难得的食物。
lines.en: Bread is a rare treat for the rotten cultist.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒盯着地上的面包，眼中露出渴望的神色。
lines.en: The rotten cultist eyeing the bread on the ground with desire.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒在面包附近徘徊，等待机会。
lines.en: The rotten cultist wanders near the bread, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒对新鲜面包垂涎欲滴。
lines.en: The rotten cultist drools over fresh bread.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒吃下最后一块面包，眼中露出满足的神情。
lines.en: The rotten cultist finishes the last piece of bread, with satisfaction in his eyes

lines.zh: 你的剑击中了腐烂邪教徒，他倒下了一点。
lines.en: Your sword hits the rotten cultist, knocking him down slightly.

lines.zh: 你的斧头劈向腐烂邪教徒，他痛苦地叫喊着。
lines.en: Your axe slices at the rotten cultist, making him scream in pain.

lines.zh: 你用箭矢攻击腐烂邪教徒，他踉跄后退。
lines.en: Your arrow hits the rotten cultist, making him stagger back.

lines.zh: 你的枪击中了腐烂邪教徒，他身体摇晃。
lines.en: Your gun hits the rotten cultist, making him sway.

lines.zh: 你的剑划过腐烂邪教徒的身体，他痛苦地扭曲。
lines.en: Your sword slices through the rotten cultist, making him contort in pain.

lines.zh: 你的剑刺中腐烂邪教徒的心脏，他倒下了。
lines.en: Your sword pierces the rotten cultist's heart, making him fall.

lines.zh: 你的弓箭击中腐烂邪教徒，他蹒跚着后退。
lines.en: Your arrow hits the rotten cultist, making him stumble back.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍中了腐烂邪教徒的头盔，他倒下。
lines.en: Your sword slices through the rotten cultist's helmet, making him fall.

lines.zh: 你的攻击撞上了腐烂邪教徒，他踉跄后退。
lines.en: Your attack hits the rotten cultist, making him stagger back.

lines.zh: 你的剑击中了腐烂邪教徒，他倒地不起。
lines.en: Your sword hits the rotten cultist, making him fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒盯着你，眼中充满了渴望。
lines.en: The rotten cultist eyeing you with desire in his eyes.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒开始向你发出诱惑的低语。
lines.en: The rotten cultist starts whispering seductively to you.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒试图接近你，寻求交配。
lines.en: The rotten cultist approaches you, seeking to mate.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒发出诱惑的声音，试图吸引你的注意。
lines.en: The rotten cultist emits a seductive sound, trying to catch your attention.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒向你发出求爱的信号。
lines.en: The rotten cultist signals to you, in a mating attempt.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒试图与你进行交配。
lines.en: The rotten cultist attempts to mate with you.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒对你发出诱惑，希望能与你交配。
lines.en: The rotten cultist tries to seduce you, hoping to mate.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒向你发出求爱的声音。
lines.en: The rotten cultist emits mating sounds.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒在你附近徘徊，试图寻找交配机会。
lines.en: The rotten cultist wanders near you, looking for a mating opportunity.

lines.zh: 腐烂邪教徒盯着你，渴望着与你交配。
lines.en: The rotten cultist eyeing you, desiring to mate with you.

lines.zh: 它的破布护甲随风摇曳。
lines.en: Its tattered armor flutters in the breeze.

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒啃咬着腐骨。
lines.en: Rotten Cultist gnaws on decayed bone.
Its eyes are filled with malice.

lines.zh: 腐尸的强化版，警惕着你。
腐烂的邪教徒在远处窥视。
腐烂的邪教徒嘶哑地叫喊。
腐烂的邪教徒挥舞着镰刀。
腐烂的邪教徒的骨头掉落了。
lines.en: Decayed bones fall off Rotten Cultist.

lines.zh: 你已被腐烂的邪教徒锁定。
lines.en: Rotten Cultist has locked onto you.

lines.zh: 邪教的神，要我先取你的血。
lines.en: The cult's god wants your blood first.

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒准备攻击。
腐烂的邪教徒瞄准了你。
腐烂的邪教徒的眼神变亮了。
腐烂的邪教徒开始行动。

lines.en: It views you as an enemy.

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒在追踪你。
腐烂的邪教徒对你发出威胁。
腐烂的邪教徒准备吞噬你。
lines.en: Rotten Cultist prepares to devour you.
Your blood will run into the stone trough...
Seize him, tie him to the slab...

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒寻找目标。
lines.en: Rotten Cultist searches for a target.

lines.zh: 它在寻找可以攻击的对象。
腐烂的邪教徒的视线锁定。
腐烂的邪教徒瞄准了骨头。
腐烂的邪教徒瞄准了远处的目标。
lines.en: Rotten Cultist targets the distant target.

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒盯着腐骨。
lines.en: Rotten Cultist stares at the decayed bones.

lines.zh: 腐烂的邪教徒寻找食物。

lines.en: Don't run. The offering must be whole...
Your throat is right at my blade...
I crouch down to look at you...
The idol's eyes turn to you...
I can smell that you're afraid...
One step, two. Don't back away...
The blade points at your ribs...
Rotten bone rattles at your feet...
I collect you for the god...

lines.zh: 腐烂的力量从骨头里涨。
lines.en: Rotten strength swells from my bones.
The bone knife goes into your gut!
The slab waits for your head!
Don't scream. The god is listening!

lines.zh: 我身上的邪教护甲已经烂了。
lines.en: My cult armor has rotted through.

lines.zh: 邪教的祷词，从我喉咙里漏出。
lines.en: The cult's prayer leaks from my throat.
A believer crawling out of a rotten corpse...
I rise from the pile of corpses...
The cult's fire never went out...
Sputtering as it falls, flesh burning.

lines.zh: 惨叫一声，从半空中摔下。
lines.en: A scream as it falls from midair.

lines.zh: 发出尖锐的叫声，水中腐烂。
lines.en: A shrill cry, rotting in the water.

lines.zh: 被爆炸震得发出嘶嘶声。

lines.en: A scream as it's hit by an arrow.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，被魔法攻击。

lines.en: A scream as lightning strikes it.
Sputtering as it falls into the void.
